observations.transform_policy: Positive uniform placement scales and rotations are intentional for shared instances and the Diver root; no remaining modifiers.

origins_far_from_geometry_center.reason: Diver accessories share the chest coordinate frame.

observations.origin_policy: Rocks use base pivots; corals/kelp use root pivots; Diver accessories use the assembly coordinate frame. These intentionally differ from geometry centers.

contacts.method: Actual component base vertices raycast vertically onto final terrain; minimum gap <= 1mm indicates sampled base contact. Lip vertices must clear terrain by 45mm. Decoration BVH surface overlap checked separately. Not a global self-intersection proof.
